name: Pathing::FollowRightWall
notes: Was Pathing_sub_4a4050. (settler, state) ret 8: after a blocked TraceLine: unless path_mode & 0xc0 or DistanceAlong(hit - trace) >= 0, two walkers (right hand on the wall: turning down from the blocked direction; left hand: turning up) take one round each; reaching the trace point in the first round: EAX = 0x20.
